prompt: Create a vertical photorealistic portrait at golden hour of a woman standing behind a hanging piece of translucent beige linen. The linen fills most of the frame from the upper left to the lower center, with a visible coarse woven texture, wrinkles, warm backlighting, and a dark folded hem along the top and right edge to show the cloth ends cleanly. The subject’s head, messy hair silhouette, shoulders, and torso appear as a soft dark shadow diffused through the fabric, with no facial features visible. On the right side, one bare forearm and hand emerges in front of the linen, sharply occluding the cloth and pinching its right edge between thumb and fingers; the arm is rim-lit by the sun and set against open sky. A simple clothesline runs horizontally across the top with exactly one dark clothespin near the upper right. Background: out-of-focus hills or countryside at sunset, warm amber sky, bright sun glow near the right edge, shallow depth of field. Emphasize the optical depth paradox: the linen hides the face and body while the visible arm is in front of the linen, with sky behind the arm. Use natural documentary photography, 35mm lens feel, soft grain, warm contrast, no text, no watermark.
